listing.name: Exerelin Mod Pack for Windows x64 bit for .62a
listing.summary: Hey everyone I love doing mod packs for my favorite games! Here's a pack I made that includes almost all factions that are compatible with exerelin. It will also load without exerelin in a regular campaign if thats your thing ;).
listing.aiSummary: Bundles numerous faction mods and quality-of-life tools into a single package for Windows 64-bit systems.

description:
DOWNLOAD:
https://docs.google.com/file/d/0B0yvClkqS5sydWI0dHg5REpjb2M

Hey everyone I love doing mod packs for my favorite games! Here's a pack I made that includes almost all factions that are compatible with exerelin. It will also load without exerelin in a regular campaign if thats your thing  ;).

I've included a readme that goes more in depth about the mod pack.

Heres an excerpt from the readme

Mods Included:
Factions:
Bushi
Hiigaran Descendants
Gedune
Neutrino Corp
Junk Pirates
Shadowyards Heavy Industries
Zorg
Kadur Theocracy
ASP Syndicate
Blackrock Drive Yards
Nomads
Valkyrians
Citadel Fleet
Objectless Research Institute
Project Batavia
Mayorate
P9 Colony Group
DSTech Corp Fleet
Interstellar Federation

Tools:
LazyLib

Quality of Life:
Combat Radar
Tore Up Plenty

Requirements
Ram:
64 bit Operating System
Minimum 4 gigs
Recommended 6 gigs

Java Runtime Environment 64 bit > Included in the mod !!!Windows Version Only!!!

Modded vmprams file included in the mod

Starsector 0.6.2a

Installation Instructions.

1. Install Starsector 0.6.2a
2. Make a back up of your mods folder vmprams file and jre folder
3. Delete everything in your mod folder, delete the jre folder and vmprams file
4. Copy the jre folder mods folder and vmprams file to the starsector folder
5. Play the game.

Troubleshooting
This collection of mods is not guaranteed to work on your system and I am almost 100% sure it wont work on a 32 bit system.
This is a very ram intensive mod pack and many files are loaded into memory. If your ram and/or cpu is slow or faulty or if you simply dont have enough you will get a null error crash.
The thing you can do in this instance is deselect some factions that you are not interested in having in your game.

Credits:
Thanks so much tot he makers of Starsector and all these beautiful and wonderful mods. I have had hours and hours and hours of enjoyment and none of this would be possible without you guys!

aiDescription: Includes a collection of faction mods compatible with Exerelin, along with LazyLib and quality-of-life enhancements like Combat Radar. It also contains a bundled Java Runtime Environment and modified virtual memory parameters for Windows. The pack can be used with or without Exerelin installed.
